name: node packages self conceptualize as language bundles presented as micro enterprises
asks: a metro-enterprise IS a language IS a thermodesic shape IS a IS a. And we don't need to prove that in Lean but like... We keep paying for 'oooh what we're deriving is literally little packets of language that all mesh together' as a conclusion over and over because our own top level resources, the way things are, the actual offices duties, skills, architectural documents, none of this stuff really makes this CLEAR. And that's silly because we should just have the standard set of documents that a business should have for all this, properly well formed, proper offices, etc. [...] we are not realizing our CORE schema properly, the ones that actually like, make our shit work. Like... it is not that we are missing the word thermodesic. It is that the content itself does not model these concepts as the way the world works. Node packages are not self-conceptualized as RMN Language bundles presented as Metro-Enterprises, so I have to keep saying this. And our offices, skills, duties, for doing this stuff, don't look at that way. [...] I need THAT gap closed, not by inventing new stuff, but by closing the semantic gaps that currently exist for no good reason. [Chairperson's order, session of 2026-07-16; the settlement of registers of nomenclature across the ecosystem through formal nomenclature settlement inquiries, derivations, procedures, and processes, realized through the meeting of observed requirements by the doing of actions as work done by characters serving as officers in offices fulfilling their duties.]
